description:
Speaking to ET NOW, Saurabh Mukherjea, Marcellus Investment Managers, said that the economy is improving & fiscal position is better than expected. Focus on structural stories than macro stories. Talking about the exposure on the market, he believes midcap lenders post stable profit growth. He is optimistic about specialty chemicals & the midcap IT sector. Further stating his investment in the market, he likes TCS in IT services & L&T Tech in the midcap pack. He had an increased position in ICICI Lombard. What is his view on new IPOs, and LIC IPO? To know all, watch the full interview on The Market to find out all the details.
